{{hatnote|Historical official Players Committee website domain. For the modern official site see [https://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org].}}

'''swccgpc.com''' was the official website domain of the Star Wars CCG [[Players Committee]] (PC) until June 2009, when the PC moved to starwarsccg.org.

== Role ==

By '''6 November 2002''' the domain hosted ''The SWCCG Player's Committee'', the official website for the Star Wars Customizable Card Game.<ref name="swccgpc2002s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 6 November 2002)</ref> That first capture still notes "placeholder pages in a few links".<ref name="swccgpc2002s" /> On '''6 December 2002''' the site posted a review of Card Vault.<ref name="pc-dec02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/december02archives.htm December Updates], swccgpc.com (6 December 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221911/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/december02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> On '''6 February 2003''' the site moved to a frames format and added a Resources page, Advocate biographies and a Shadow Squadron volunteer locator.<ref name="pc-feb03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221707/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/february03archives.htm February 03 Updates], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 23 April 2003.</ref> On '''1 April 2003''' the PC opened an Online Affiliate Store on swccgpc.com through a new affiliate relationship with Universal Cards, offering discounted Star Wars CCG, Young Jedi, Jedi Knights and Ultra Pro merchandise; orders were processed through Universal Cards' own website, and the PC received a small commission on each purchase to offset its operating costs.<ref name="pc-apr03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/april03archives.htm April Updates], swccgpc.com (1 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> By June 2004 the PC had formed a "WebGroup" to discuss and coordinate the website, with [[Keith Allen]] as webmaster and [[Jason Robinette]], [[David Destefanis]], John Davis, [[Kevin Brownell]] and [[Nick Kolnik]] as its other members.<ref name="pc-newadv04">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/NewAdvocates.htm New Advocates! Not 1 but 2!], swccgpc.com (2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040603214022/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/NewAdvocates.htm Internet Archive]</ref> The domain also hosted the 2001 RamapoCon 3 convention site (7–10 June 2001, Ramapo College, Mahwah, New Jersey).<ref name="pc-ramapo">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071217070344/http://www.swccgpc.com/ramapocon/index.html RamapoCon 3], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 17 December 2007.</ref> On 11 October 2004 [[Kevin Brownell]] announced that the files of [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds|Virtual Set 6]] and [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire|Virtual Set 7]] on the site's virtual cards page had been redone with the current, post-errata texts.<ref name="pcf-4041-55058">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55058#55058 V-set 6 and 7 redone!], Kevin Brownell (CubsFan), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041031160839/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55080%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 18 May 2005 [[Michael Carr]] updated the site's links, adding links to the Star Wars archives on Decipher's site and to jasonmaas.net/swccg.<ref name="pcf-5457-77768">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=77768#77768 A Question for the masses.], Michael Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (18 May 2005). In August 2008 the site showed a banner reading "Come back to the game you love", and the PC had a new SWCCG PC logo; players on the forum asked for stickers, T-shirts and other merchandise with them.<ref name="pcf-22802-330732">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330732#330732 Cool banner thing], Indiana Jones Jedi Knight, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083935/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=22802 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-22802-330954">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330954#330954 Cool banner thing], woundedwookiee, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 August 2008). News], swccgpc.com (October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081017062757/http://swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php? Internet Archive]</ref> On '''3 October 2008''' the PC Store began selling pre-cut [[V-slips|V slips]], cut to order by [[Mike Tomashewski]] in partnership with the PC, with quantity discounts.<ref name="pc-news6">[http://www.swccgpc.com/news/news.php?id=6 New Service on the PC Store- V slips, cut to order!], swccgpc.com (3 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225913/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=6 Internet Archive]</ref> Its "Who We Are" page described the 480-card Cube and online play through GEngine, Holotable and swccgonline.com.<ref name="pc-about08">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080925100950/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/about/ Who We Are] (September 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 25 September 2008.</ref> On '''10 June 2009''', PC news announced completion of a move to a new server and forwarding to the new domain '''StarWarsCCG.org''' (starwarsccg.org).<ref name="domain2009s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102740/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=69 New Domain and Server], starwarsccg.org (posted 10 June 2009; Wayback 6 July 2009)</ref> News pages still served on swccgpc.com in 2010 gave their permalinks on www.starwarsccg.org.<ref name="pc-news87">[https://web.archive.org/web/20100506000733/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=87 Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!], posted by Rogue4 (12 March 2010), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 6 May 2010.</ref>

By '''July 2019''' swccgpc.com hosted an unrelated third-party site, "SW:CCG DB (Beta)", a deckbuilder.<ref name="pc-2019about">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190721231010/http://swccgpc.com/about About (SW:CCG DB)] (July 2019), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 21 July 2019.</ref>

== Forums (2002–2005) ==

On 4 November 2002 [[Jason Robinette]], posting as JasonRed3, set out the rules of the swccgpc.com forums: the boards were for discussing current and future SWCCG, such as rules questions, play experiences and tournament announcements; dream cards could not be discussed there, as Decipher's message board still offered a place for them; and trading or selling cards, flaming other members and bashing other card games were not allowed.<ref name="pcf-81-857">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=857#857 Dream Cards, sales, trading, & discussion &#91;PLEASE READ&#93;], JasonRed3, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 November 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050218090812/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=857%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The boards included Announcements, General Discussion, tournament announcement boards and discussion boards for SWCCG, [[Young Jedi]] and the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game|Jedi Knights]] game, a [[Classic]] Format board and, in April 2003, a board for the live coverage of the [[2003 DPC Chicago]].<ref name="pcf-1674-28428">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28428#28428 Cleaning up the Forums], Andrew Howard, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 June 2003). In July 2005 Scott Lingrell wrote that the main page was being updated two to three times a week, that Decipher's card lists were available through Ruddog while the PC looked into whether it could host them, and that the old Collecting thread had been lost.<ref name="pcf-6561-88430">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=88430#88430 A Recap and more questions.], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 July 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618064056/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=89004 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Nick Kolnik]] replied that he had saved eight or nine pages of the collecting thread after searching Google for each page, and that the thread itself no longer existed in the forum's database.<ref name="pcf-6561-88451">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=88451#88451 A Recap and more questions.], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 July 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618064056/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=89004 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Michael Carr]] had opened a Trade/Collecting Questions thread on 5 June 2005 to recreate what had been lost,<ref name="pcf-5796-81168">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=81168#81168 Trade/Collecting Questions], Michael Carr, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618084051/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=81971 Internet Archive]</ref> and in December 2005 Lingrell reposted saved pages of the old thread there.<ref name="pcf-5796-113113">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=113113#113113 Trade/Collecting Questions], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 December 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618084301/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5796&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=100 Internet Archive]</ref> In September 2008 the forums offered premium memberships, paid through PayPal and including a six-month option, which gave members an avatar and access to premium forums.<ref name="pcf-22212-335037">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335037#335037 Going premium], citizenSwanky, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080916195925/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335040&sid=d06ad6437369bcd26a837f9f518a057c Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-22212-335040">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335040#335040 Going premium], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080916195925/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335040&sid=d06ad6437369bcd26a837f9f518a057c Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-22212-336098">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336098#336098 Going premium], NateA, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080916195925/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=335040&sid=d06ad6437369bcd26a837f9f518a057c Internet Archive]</ref>

== Forums (2006–2008) ==

In June 2006 the forum added a points system; PapaLorax said it had not yet been decided what the points would be used for. A DONATE link and forum sections for trading, selling, premium members and auctions appeared at the same time, and Kolnik said that information on premium memberships would be "coming soon".<ref name="pcf-10317-141277">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141277#141277 Point], PapaLorax, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618063128/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141421 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-10317-141462">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141462#141462 Point], Spencer_00_us, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618063128/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141421 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-10317-141500">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141500#141500 Point], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618063128/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141421 Internet Archive]</ref> By October 2008 the forum had a board for the World Championships (viewforum.php?f=353).<ref name="pcf-23633-342626">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342626#342626 threads about worlds?], AnakinSolo, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081021233940/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342626&sid=198be8cdf7bda3b05cc740ccf203ad9f Internet Archive]</ref> In December 2008 members could view the forum with an "AcidTechBlood" skin or a "silver" view; [[Tim Simon]] noted that attachments, such as the Worlds 2008 decklists, did not show in AcidTechBlood.<ref name="pcf-24244-355335">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=355335#355335 WORLDS 2008 DECKLISTS], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 December 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081207045343/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=355335&sid=da800f192a94d4e0badb0ea8628c4ff7 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Download library (2006–2008) ==

On 17 June 2006 the site's PHP-Nuke Downloads module held 62 downloads in five categories: Rules Documents, its Spanish-language subcategory SWCCG en Espanol, Set Spoilers, Tournament Forms and Virtual Cards.<ref name="pc-dl06">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads Downloads], swccgpc.com (17 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617215958/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads Internet Archive]</ref> The Tournament Forms, all added on 27 April 2006, were the Championship Event Application, the Prize Support Application, the SWCCG Tournament Command Card and the deck list required for Championship Circuit events.<ref name="pc-dl2-06">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=2&orderby=dateD Downloads: Tournament Forms], swccgpc.com (17 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617222351/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=2&orderby=dateD Internet Archive]</ref> Spoilers of the Decipher expansions and products, a Decipher Complete Spoiler and spoilers of Virtual Sets 1–8 were added on 23 May 2006, and spoilers of Virtual Sets 9, 11, 12 and 13 and of the Virtual Defensive Shields on 17 August 2007.<ref name="pc-dlpop07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=MostPopular&ratenum=50&ratetype=num Downloads: Most Popular (top 50)], swccgpc.com (28 October 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071028141614/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=MostPopular&ratenum=50&ratetype=num Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-dl4-07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=4&orderby=hitsA Downloads: Set Spoilers], swccgpc.com (28 October 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071028142204/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=4&orderby=hitsA Internet Archive]</ref> The Spanish-language documents were "SWCCG Libro de Reglas v2 - 1998", the Special Edition rulebook in Spanish (added 30 May 2006), and "Gameterms en Español" (added 31 May 2006).<ref name="pc-dl5-07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=5&orderby=hitsA Downloads: Rules Documents/SWCCG en Español], swccgpc.com (26 October 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143223/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=5&orderby=hitsA Internet Archive]</ref>

By October 2007 the library also held the "Icon Guide - version 2007" (added 3 July 2006), the "No Such Thing As Luck - Format Rules" (current as of 10 June 2005; added 20 August 2006), the "Official Tournament Guide" (added 2 October 2006), the "Game Aid: Hyperoute Navigation Chart" (added 26 October 2006), the two issues of ''[[Obi-Wan's Journal (newsletter)|Obi-Wan's Journal]]'' (23 October 2006 and 31 January 2007) and the "Advanced Rulebook - Legal July 29th 2007" (added 12 July 2007), described as replacing all earlier rules documents.<ref name="pc-dl3-07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=3 Downloads: Rules Documents], swccgpc.com (24 October 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024151320/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=3 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-dl6-07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=6&orderby=ratingA Downloads: Tournament Resources/Alt. Format & Scenarios], swccgpc.com (30 October 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071030143035/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=6&orderby=ratingA Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-dl2-07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=2&orderby=titleA Downloads: Tournament Resources], swccgpc.com (30 October 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071030143522/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=2&orderby=titleA Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-dl1" /><ref name="pc-dl7" /> Its Virtual Cards category carried the virtual sets, most with text "current as of August 19, 2006"; [[Virtual Set 12]] (added 22 August 2006, text as of 9 January 2007) was the most downloaded file, at 9,679 downloads on 28 October 2007.<ref name="pc-dlpop07" /><ref name="pc-dl1" />

The relaunched site's download library of September 2008 had four categories on 25 September 2008: Enhanced Packs (14 downloads), Rules Documents (6), Newsletters (2) and Virtual Cards (16).<ref name="pc-dl08">[http://www.swccgpc.com/downloads/ Downloads], swccgpc.com (25 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080925101001/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/downloads/ Internet Archive]</ref> On 24 September 2008 it posted the Advanced Rulebook, an Advanced Rulebook quarterly update of September 2008, a Characteristics Rule Card with the characteristic rules from the June 2008 supplement, an SWCCG Icon Sheet, and the Spanish-language Special Edition rulebook and Gameterms.<ref name="pc-dl08-3">[http://www.swccgpc.com/downloads/category.php?id=3 Downloads: Rules Documents], swccgpc.com (13 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081013105759/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/downloads/category.php?id=3 Internet Archive]</ref> On 27 September 2008 it posted the Official Tournament Guide, a Star Wars Online Play Tournament Guide, the Cube format card listing, the tournament decklist and the Tournament Command Card.<ref name="pc-dl08-4">[http://www.swccgpc.com/downloads/category.php?id=4 Downloads: Tournament Resources], swccgpc.com (13 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081013105804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/downloads/category.php?id=4 Internet Archive]</ref> The Enhanced Packs were themed packs of Rules cards, virtual card slips and optional errata slips, such as Enhanced Artillery and Enhanced Pilots.<ref name="pc-dl08-2">[http://www.swccgpc.com/downloads/category.php?id=2 Downloads: Enhanced Packs], swccgpc.com (13 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081013105754/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/downloads/category.php?id=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Virtual Cards category held [[Virtual Set 9]] to [[Virtual Set 16]], posted on 22 September 2008, the Virtual Defensive Shields, and a Current Errata Sheet (2 October 2008) of all cards given errata since the re-edit of all Virtual Cards released on 4 December 2006.<ref name="pc-dl08-7">[http://www.swccgpc.com/downloads/category.php?id=7 Downloads: Virtual Cards], swccgpc.com (13 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081013105814/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/downloads/category.php?id=7 Internet Archive]</ref> The library also offered the Hyperroute Navigation Chart (2 October 2008) as a game aid,<ref name="pc-dl08-8">[http://www.swccgpc.com/downloads/category.php?id=8 Downloads: Game Aid], swccgpc.com (13 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081013105819/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/downloads/category.php?id=8 Internet Archive]</ref> and, under Player Articles and Newsletters, the [[2nd Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks]] (2 October 2008), issue 1 of ''[[dGamer]]'' and issue 1 of ''Obi-Wan's Journal''.<ref name="pc-dl10-08">[http://www.swccgpc.com/downloads/category.php?id=10 Downloads: Player Articles and Newsletters], swccgpc.com (13 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081013105749/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/downloads/category.php?id=10 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Online Rules Database (2006–2009) ==

By 10 October 2006 the site hosted a MediaWiki rules site at /wiki/, named the "Online Rules Database", whose main page welcomed readers to "the SWCCGPC Wiki".<ref name="ord-tatocc">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Tatooine_Occupation Tatooine Occupation - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (10 October 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080707185152/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/wiki/index.php?title=Tatooine_Occupation Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ord-main07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Main_Page Main Page - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (27 September 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070927192654/http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Main_Page Internet Archive]</ref> It arranged rulings by card title, by game term and by card type, with card lists from 2 to L and from M to Z, a Characteristics category and a card list for each expansion.<ref name="ord-main07" /> Each card page gave the card's image, lore, game text, expansion and rarity, the cards that pull it, its characteristics, its matching pilots and the rules topics that apply to it; game-term pages such as "Site" gave the rule text.<ref name="ord-chimaera">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Chimaera Chimaera - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (17 November 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070927192705/http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Chimaera Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ord-site">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Site Site - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (20 December 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903084005/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/wiki/index.php?title=Site Internet Archive]</ref> In May 2008 the Characteristics category held 72 pages, the Expansion Card List category 37 and the Rulings by Card Type category 17.<ref name="ord-char">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Category:Characteristics Category:Characteristics - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (2 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080502103349/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/wiki/index.php?title=Category:Characteristics Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ord-exp">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Category:Expansion_Card_List Category:Expansion Card List - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (2 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080502103354/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/wiki/index.php?title=Category:Expansion_Card_List Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ord-type">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Category:Rulings_by_Card_Type Category:Rulings by Card Type - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (2 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080502103404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/wiki/index.php?title=Category:Rulings_by_Card_Type Internet Archive]</ref> The main page was last changed on 13 February 2007; it had been viewed 10,402 times by 27 September 2007 and 20,507 times by 2 May 2008.<ref name="ord-main07" /><ref name="ord-main08">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Main_Page&printable=yes Main Page - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (2 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080502111146/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/wiki/index.php?title=Main_Page&printable=yes Internet Archive]</ref> Pages for virtual cards were still being created on 25 April 2008,<ref name="ord-rc">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Special:Recentchanges Recent changes - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (2 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080502111222/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/wiki/index.php?title=Special:Recentchanges Internet Archive]</ref> and the wiki was still online on 4 March 2009.<ref name="ord-wedge">[http://www.swccgpc.com/wiki/index.php?title=Commander_Wedge_Antilles Commander Wedge Antilles - Online Rules Database], swccgpc.com (4 March 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090304103800/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/wiki/index.php?title=Commander_Wedge_Antilles Internet Archive]</ref> On 25 September 2008 the Rules page of the relaunched site said the PC was building a database of all the SWCCG rules and cards, to be a single, trusted source for rules and card information, and in the meantime linked the [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1|Advanced Rulebook]] PDF (AR1.7.1).<ref name="pc-rules08">[http://www.swccgpc.com/rules/ Rules], swccgpc.com (25 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080925013642/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/rules/ Internet Archive]</ref>
